name: tl_f1_curves
title: Two invented languages, taught one after the other in one pass
caption: Learner 1.0, one-pass recording. Velenic's held-out loss falls from 4.6625 to 2.8880 nats during its own teach and reads 2.8871 after Morvath is taught. Morvath's falls from 4.3636 to 2.2842 during its teach.
alt: Two panels on a shared loss axis and a shared update axis from 0 to 627. Each shows a pale raw training-loss trace with a darker 15-update average during that language's own teach, and three amber held-out points.
smoothing: trailing 15-update mean, drawn over the raw trace
